representativeSnapshot.kind: production-like disposable database containing V1 and V2 post appearance rows

rowCountQueries: select schema_version, count(*) from public.post_appearances group by schema_version order by schema_version
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: No rows are rewritten; the accepted schema-version set expands from 1/2 to 1/2/3

execution.resumeStrategy: Rerun the idempotent drop/add/validate sequence before any V3 writer is enabled
execution.idempotency: The migration only replaces one named CHECK constraint and performs no data mutation

quarantine.strategy: No tenant keys or user data are inferred, backfilled, or quarantined

constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Add the expanded CHECK as NOT VALID, validate it separately, and confirm V1/V2 rows remain accepted before enabling V3 writes

recovery.rollback: Before V3 rows exist, restore the prior schema_version IN (1, 2) CHECK in a forward migration
recovery.forwardFix: After V3 rows exist, correct the renderer or constraint in an additive migration; never rewrite immutable snapshots

queries: select conname, convalidated, pg_get_constraintdef(oid) from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.post_appearances'::regclass and conname = 'post_appearances_schema_version_check'
select schema_version, count(*) from public.post_appearances group by schema_version order by schema_version
